# verified by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:verifiedBy`](gmeow-verifiedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/verifiedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent that produced a verification result. Non-functional: joint verification by multiple agents is valid.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:verifiedBy`](gmeow-verifiedBy.md) from [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent or software that produced a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) — the verifier whose standpoint the verdict is held from ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): a result is one verifier's observation, not a global fact).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the agent that ISSUED the attestation (that is [`gmeow:attester`](gmeow-attester.md)) and avoid forcing a single verifier — joint verification is valid, so it stays non-functional.

### How to use

- Bind the verifying [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) on the [`VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md); competing verdicts from different verifiers coexist as separate results, each with its own [`gmeow:verifiedBy`](gmeow-verifiedBy.md).
